source_findings.observed_entity_to_world_entity: WorldModel.ingest_observations creates or refreshes WorldEntity from sensor rows, retaining kind, relative estimate, confidence, uncertainty, bounded distance support, provenance, source kind, and body schema.
source_findings.bounded_spatial_support: distance_support_upper_bound plus support_center_dx/support_center_dy/support_radius are accepted only from finite nonnegative observation support and are propagated body-relatively by VerifiedMotionDelta.
source_findings.remembered_estimate: Unobserved entities become REMEMBERED_ESTIMATE under object_persistence; persistence does not promote them back to CURRENT_OBSERVATION.
source_findings.verified_motion: apply_verified_motion updates estimated relative state and bounded support using only verified body motion, without world coordinates.
source_findings.policy_exposure: policy_observations exports only REMEMBERED_ESTIMATE rows with bounded support and includes provenance, support semantics, body schema, and verified recovery metadata.
source_findings.runtime_injection: runtime ingests current sensor rows, then appends WorldModel.policy_observations before arbitration.
source_findings.current_charge_strengthening: observe_outcome currently increments verified_recovery_count and strengthens confidence/persistence only for successful CHARGE on directly observed resource/novel_crystal.
source_findings.current_rest_gap: successful REST on a directly observed supported rest entity currently does not increment verified_recovery_count or receive equivalent recovery-landmark retention.
source_findings.restart: WorldEntity fields, including support and verified recovery metadata, are included in WorldModel.to_state and restored by WorldModel.from_state.

qualification_requirements: direct current observation rather than world-model memory
negative_guards: failed or denied execution does not qualify
unsupported or memory-only observation does not qualify
unrelated entity kinds do not qualify
no hidden habitat truth enters policy
no direct action selection or need priority is introduced

production_change_required: generalize the existing CHARGE-only verified recovery strengthening to the existing REST/rest interaction convention and use verified recovery count when deciding whether a rest landmark receives existing slow/zero persistence treatment; preserve resource behavior byte/semantically.
